$comment: #2112 -- every Json column and every feed key outside a provider mapping table in packages/core-api/prisma/schema.prisma, with its owner ticket or the reason it is allowed. Read by scripts/check-schema-shapes.mjs. Entries only go: --update removes one whose column is gone, and rules:check:baseline-ratchet refuses a new one unless scripts/baseline-raises.json declares it.
json:BackgroundJob.payload: allowed: the job envelope, validated per job type by background-job-payloads.ts
json:BackgroundJob.result: allowed: the job envelope's result, validated per job type by background-job-payloads.ts
json:ContestConfigTemplate.configJson: #2018 (slice 18b) for the scoring part; #2120 for the contest settings, validated by the shared zod schema until then
json:ContestConfiguration.configJson: #2120: contest settings, validated by the shared zod schema until they become typed columns
json:ContestLeaderboardSnapshot.board: allowed: a cached projection of computed standings, never queried by field
json:Participant.injuryStatus: #2121: becomes an enum and columns, or moves with the roster rows in #2025 (slice 21)
json:PlatformRuntimeConfig.configJson: allowed: runtime settings validated by their schema
json:PlatformRuntimeConfigHistory.newJso: allowed: the history of the runtime settings
json:PlatformRuntimeConfigHistory.previo: allowed: the history of the runtime settings
json:ProviderSyncRun.detailsJson: allowed: the raw provider response kept for audit (integration boundary)
json:ProviderSyncRun.stats: allowed: the raw provider response kept for audit (integration boundary)
key:EmailMessage.providerMessageId: allowed: the email vendor's message id, owned by the email adapter, not a sports feed key
